walkthrough.title: Two prefix sums with the same remainder mod 3 bracket a path whose sum is divisible by 3.

steps.text: At 2, the prefix leaves remainder 2; 0 earlier prefixes match. Total 0.
At 1, the prefix leaves remainder 0; 1 earlier prefix match. Total 1.
At 4, the prefix leaves remainder 0; 1 earlier prefix match. Total 2.
